fix_summary.root_cause: TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory: exist_ok=False in mkdir() can raise FileExistsError if directory is created concurrently between the exists() check and mkdir() call
fix_summary.solution: Changed exist_ok=False to exist_ok=True in parent.mkdir() call. The file-as-directory validation done earlier (lines 35-40) still provides security against path confusion attacks.

risks.security_impact: None - file-as-directory validation still works correctly
risks.breaking_changes: None - this is a pure bug fix
risks.edge_cases: The fix makes the code more resilient to race conditions without changing behavior for normal cases
